positive_snippets: This hotel is having luxurious facilities and having good respect with its clients. Good behaviour, nice food, rooms are very cleaned with obedient staff. Washrooms, rooms, ambiance are very beautiful. It is my personal experience being shared to everyone on this site. It’s approached on the main road and no problem of parking.
negative_snippets:
Very bad experience at this hotel. The room was dirty, had a foul smell, and there were damp patches on the walls. The toilet and bathroom were unclean and seemed previously used — the bucket, taps, and floor were filthy and slippery. There were also too many mosquitoes in the room, making it very uncomfortable to stay. The mattress and bed were dirty and unhygienic.

Overall, the hygiene and maintenance were extremely poor, and the service was disappointing. The room rate was very high compared to the condition provided. I booked for one day but will never stay here again or recommend this hotel to anyone.
